items.summary: Q: How satisfying was it to get that 5th? "Yeah I mean...it's for fifth place so there's a cap on the excitement but no certainly made it more exciting at the end which was good fun. items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: McLaren will start on the 3rd row, is that the best you could've achieved today? "Um...I thi…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：McLaren 将从第3排起步，这是你们今天能做到的最好成绩吗？"嗯……我觉得我们希望不是。希望不会是这样。但我觉得现实地说，我们知道自己的位置。我们目前就是不够快。我觉得所有圈都很难拼在一起，肯定还有更多潜力。但我想大多数人在新加坡的一节比赛后都会有这种评论，所以。是的，就是不够快。"
items.summary: Q: McLaren will start on the 3rd row, is that the best you could've achieved today? "Um...I think we hoped that no. That wouldn't be the case. But I think realistically we know where we sit. We're just not quite quick enough at the moment. I think all the laps were a bit tricky to get together and there was definitely a bit more in it. But I imagine that most people have that comment after a session around Singapore so. Yeah just not quite quick enough."

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @laurogeitabat：Oscar 谈他对赛车的感受：“赛车的整体感觉和平时没什么不同。你必须真的把它逼到极限才能跑得快，而且，当我们用软胎增加了一点抓地力后，情况好了一些，但仍然是个挑战。”

items.summary_zh: Oscar 谈他对赛车的感受：“赛车的整体感觉和平时没什么不同。你必须真的把它逼到极限才能跑得快，而且，当我们用软胎增加了一点抓地力后，情况好了一些，但仍然是个挑战。”

items.title: X post from @laurogeitabat: Q: how satisfied are you? oscar: pretty happy! i think that was more or less all we could've do…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @laurogeitabat：问：你有多满意？Oscar：挺开心的！我觉得这差不多是我们能做到的全部了。在冲刺赛周末，要在这里把赛车的圈速全部榨出来非常棘手。我在中性胎上很挣扎，但一换上软胎我就挺满意了。表现不错！
items.summary: Q: how satisfied are you? oscar: pretty happy! i think that was more or less all we could've done. it's very tricky on a sprint weekend to get all the lap time out of the car here. i was struggling on the medium but once i put the soft on i was pretty happy. not a bad effort! https://t.co/CO6Yi83UU4
items.summary_zh: 问：你有多满意？Oscar：挺开心的！我觉得这差不多是我们能做到的全部了。在冲刺赛周末，要在这里把赛车的圈速全部榨出来非常棘手。我在中性胎上很挣扎，但一换上软胎我就挺满意了。表现不错！
